title: Concept: Outbound request to a computed URL in javascript — review required
description: In javascript, fetch, axios, or got is called with a URL assembled from a template literal, concatenation, or request parameters. An attacker who controls the interpolated segment chooses where the server connects next, which is how SSRF reaches loopback services and cloud metadata that the public internet cannot address. Lexical matching cannot separate trusted identifiers from user input, so each hit is a review item.
applicability: javascript services that proxy, unfurl, or fetch resources named by a client.
risk: Server-side request forgery into internal networks and metadata endpoints; HIGH severity.
